reference_policy: Own generated front first; maximum five references. No external, retired, unapproved pre-existing, or reject images used.

attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production model sheet, front.png, landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG.
Draw ONE full-body FRONT view of the training construct alone on a perfectly flat light-grey #E9E9EC background, filling the canvas height with small clear margins above the head and below the feet. Soft neutral studio key light from upper left. Orthographic construction-sheet camera at mid-body height (2 m), level, no perspective exaggeration. No human figure, no silhouette, no ruler, no chart lines, no labels, no scene.
The Association's training construct: a 4 m stone figure of grey granite blocks bound with brass bands, a blank rounded head, arms like pillars, a fist-sized amber test core behind a brass grille in its chest; it moves on rails of light in the floor.
Visual construction: a heavy, blunt utilitarian test golem, plainly stone bound with metal rather than a mechanical robot. A modest-sized smooth blank round-ended granite head (no face, eyes, mouth, helmet or horns), broad rectangular torso, separate simple block pelvis, two strong straight legs about 45% of total height with a clear walk-through gap between them, broad stone feet flat on the same baseline. Head around one eighth of standing height. Two massive pillar-like arms hang neutrally with a little clear space beside the torso, simple elbow joints and squared stone hands, each with four broad fingers and one thumb, without human musculature. No clothing or weapons.
Use a few large, clean granite blocks with sparse hand-inked chips and small dry-brush marks confined to broken edges. Granite base #858B91, hard cool shadow #5F666E. No all-over speckle or tiny polygon facets. Functional plain brass bands (#B29658, shadow #7D683C) wrap around the torso, upper arms, forearms, thighs and shins and visibly clamp the blocks together; solid metal bands with a few attached rivets, no decorative belt buckles or hanging straps. These thigh and knee bands can serve as climbing rungs. A small recessed square brass frame at mid chest contains a simple brass grille of three vertical bars and two horizontal crossbars; behind it ONE fist-sized warm amber test crystal, only about 12 cm across compared with the 4 m body, amber #D5AF67, softly luminous only inside its recess. Keep it a very small test target, not a giant power reactor. No other body lights.
The front sheet should show the body clearly without floor rails, which will be documented on the details sheet. Just a faint contact shadow immediately under the feet. Silhouette strong, giant proportions consistent, clean matte stone planes, hand-drawn crisp tapered ink and a single large cel-shadow family. No atmospheric effects.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
